Neurosurgery cost in India

Brain and spine surgery in Delhi NCR is performed by experienced neurosurgeons at NABH and JCI accredited hospitals, at a fraction of Western prices. These ranges are honest estimates — your figure comes in writing within 48 hours.

Neurosurgery is priced around the complexity of your lesion and the technology it needs — awake surgery, neuronavigation or a coiling suite. Your MRI and angiogram decide the true figure.

Published ranges

What each procedure costs

Ranges are typical for Delhi NCR in 2026. The figure for your own scans comes in writing within 48 hours.

ProcedureTypical cost in India
Brain tumour surgeryCraniotomy and tumour removalUSD 6,000–12,000 Aneurysm coiling or clippingEndovascular or open, 5–8 nightsUSD 6,500–12,000 Deep brain stimulationDBS for Parkinson's and tremorUSD 15,000–25,000 Epilepsy surgeryWith video-EEG evaluationUSD 8,000–15,000

Prices in USD, inclusive of hospital and surgeon fees for the standard package. Device-dependent procedures are priced after your imaging is reviewed.

Overview

What the price includes

The package covers the surgeon and hospital fees, your room, ICU time, standard medicines and basic tests, an interpreter and your medical visa invitation letter.

It does not include flights, family hotels, or consumables outside the standard protocol — and the invoice is itemised.

  • Neurosurgeon and hospital fees
  • Room, ICU and nursing care
  • Medicines and basic tests
  • Interpreter and visa letter
Why ranges

Why the range varies

A small surface tumour and a deep lesion near speech areas are very different operations. Whether your aneurysm is coiled or clipped, and whether devices are needed, drives the price.

After reviewing your MRI and angiogram with the neurosurgeon, we confirm a fixed package figure in writing.

  • Location and size of the lesion
  • Coiling versus clipping for aneurysms
  • Use of neuronavigation or implants
  • Days in hospital and ICU
Your plan

How your case is priced

Send your MRI, CT or angiogram. Our team matches you to a neurosurgeon who operates on your condition regularly, and the package is quoted for your scan, not a template.

You receive a written opinion with the figure and a visa letter, and you can speak with the surgeon before travelling.

  • Scans reviewed by our team
  • Surgeon matched to your case
  • Fixed package price in writing
Questions

Questions about neurosurgery cost

Because the pacemaker-like device and the stereotactic planning technology dominate the cost. The surgery itself is skilled work, but the implant is the expensive part — and it is quoted in full, in writing.

We are a facilitator, not a hospital

TIB HIND does not provide medical treatment, diagnosis or emergency care. All treatment is delivered by independent, accredited hospitals and their consultants, who remain solely responsible for clinical decisions.

Costs are ranges, not quotations

Published figures are indicative ranges based on recent cases. Your final cost is set by the treating hospital after clinical assessment and can change if your treatment does.

Your medical records

Reports you send are reviewed by our medical team and are not shared with any hospital without your instruction. See our privacy and data protection policy.

This site is not for emergencies

If you have chest pain, stroke symptoms, severe bleeding or any acute deterioration, contact your local emergency services now. Do not wait for a reply from us.
